thought.text: Das Problem: Server läuft im **Dev-Mode** (tsx), nicht Production! Lass mich checken:

reasoning_content:
The index.html in dist references `/assets/main-CLZYnZ3S.js` but when we access the website, it serves from Vite dev mode at `/src/main.ts` not the built files. The server is running in development mode (tsx) not production mode (serving dist).

Looking at the HTML:
- `<script type="module" src="/src/main.ts"></script>` - This is Vite dev mode

But should be using production mode. Let me check the server bootstrap to see how it decides to serve dev vs prod.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check how server serves client 
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'dist\\|production\\|vite\\|dev' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts | head -15")
print("Dev/Prod config:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check pm2 config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /root/.pm2/ecosystem.config.js 2>&1 | head -20")
print("\nPM2 Config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
